### FullSimulation {#FullSimulation}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">experimental.FullSimulation</code></div>

eth_simulateV1 or debug_traceCall: the full picture.

```ts sdk-signature
interface FullSimulation extends SimulationBase {
  limited: false;
  backend: 'eth_simulateV1' | 'debug_traceCall';
  gas: SimulatedGas;
  balanceChanges: BalanceChange[];
  events: SimulatedEvent[];
  stateChanges: StateChange[];
  matchesPreview: PreviewComparison;
}
```

| <code>backend</code> | <span class="sdk-type">'eth_simulateV1' &#124; 'debug_traceCall'</span> |  |
| <code>gas</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#SimulatedGas">SimulatedGas</a></span> | Gas of the simulated call and what it would cost now. Balance changes exclude gas, so they compare with the preview. |
| <code>balanceChanges</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#BalanceChange">BalanceChange</a>[]</span> |  |
| <code>events</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#SimulatedEvent">SimulatedEvent</a>[]</span> |  |
| <code>stateChanges</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#StateChange">StateChange</a>[]</span> |  |

| <code>request</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./send#PreparedRequest">PreparedRequest</a></span> | The request that was simulated (`prepared.request`). `send(prepared, { simulation })` refuses a simulation of another request. |
| <code>from</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Address</span> |  |
| <code>blockNumber</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | The block simulated on top of. |

Pass the simulation to `send(prepared, { simulation })` and its warnings need acknowledging like the prepared ones. |
| <code>summary</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string[]</span> | Plain-language lines built from the result (deterministic). |

### PreviewComparison {#PreviewComparison}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">experimental.PreviewComparison</code></div>

```ts sdk-signature
interface PreviewComparison {
  status: 'match' | 'mismatch' | 'notCompared';
  ok: boolean;
  differences: string[];
  compared: string[];
  notCompared: string[];
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>status</code> | <span class="sdk-type">'match' &#124; 'mismatch' &#124; 'notCompared'</span> | - `match`: at least one thing was compared, everything the preview says   was compared, and nothing differs. - `mismatch`: something differs (`differences`). - `notCompared`: no difference was found, but the comparison is not   complete: nothing in this preview is comparable (`compared` is empty),   or a value it needed could not be read (`notCompared`). |
| <code>ok</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> | `status === 'match'`. Never true when nothing was compared. |
| <code>differences</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string[]</span> |  |
| <code>compared</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string[]</span> | What was compared (empty when the preview has nothing comparable). |
| <code>notCompared</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string[]</span> | What should have been compared and could not be (a value was not read). |

</div>

<p class="sdk-see"><a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/simulate/types.ts#L139">source</a></p>

### StateChange {#StateChange}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">type</span> <code class="sdk-qual">experimental.StateChange</code></div>

```ts sdk-signature
type StateChange =
  | {
      kind: 'value';
      address: Address;
      name: OvmValueName;
      before: bigint;
      after: bigint;
      delta: bigint;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'roles';
      address: Address;
      user: Address;
      before?: bigint;
      after: bigint;
      granted: OvmRoleName[];
      revoked: OvmRoleName[];
    }
  | {
      kind: 'ownership';
      address: Address;
      previousOwner: Address;
      newOwner: Address;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'ownershipHandover';
      address: Address;
      pendingOwner: Address;
      action: 'requested' | 'canceled';
    }
  | {
      kind: 'recipient';
      address: Address;
      recipient: 'principal' | 'reward';
      newAddress: Address;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'created';
      contract: 'ovm' | 'split';
      address: Address;
      factory: Address;
      owner: Address;
      principalRecipient?: Address;
      rewardRecipient?: Address;
      principalThreshold?: bigint;
      params?: SplitParams;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'splitUpdated';
      address: Address;
      params: SplitParams;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'paused';
      address: Address;
      paused: boolean;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'withdrawalRequest';
      source: 'event' | 'calldata';
      via: Address;
      pubkey: Hex;
      amount: bigint;
      fullExit: boolean;
      fee: bigint;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'consolidationRequest';
      source: 'event' | 'calldata';
      via: Address;
      sourcePubkey: Hex;
      targetPubkey: Hex;
      fee: bigint;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'deposit';
      pubkey: Hex;
      withdrawalCredentials: Hex;
      amount: bigint;
      index: bigint;
    };
```
